title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1982-04-15

ai_review.summary: Good-quality recording of a pleasant show highlighted by a solid Morning Dew performance
ai_review.review: All three reviewers enjoyed the concert, citing the Morning Dew as a memorable moment and describing the overall vibe as a great Dead experience. While no specific technical details are given, the positive feedback suggests the recording is listenable and the performance was solid.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4‑5) and enthusiastic comments indicate a strong show; lack of concrete recording details keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on sound clarity or mix, but overall positive reception implies the audio is acceptable for listening.
